Beckwith Burlington N. J.  Wash'n Nov. 18th 64
Hang Julia Mason For Belly Tulip Please come this
way if posy able on your re turn Beach


Beckwith Burlington N. J.  Nov. 19th 1864
Hang Brook Jones PM For Chart tulip There is
no reason why you should not go to Grain ada
yard Let me know you ad dress there yard comb


R. O. Brien Hd Qrs Army Janus  Nov. 19th 1864 
Growl Nov. Hope Nancy For Knave zebra can not
you hold on for Pebble or Pension days until
our vessel reaches you Pekin now on the way
yoke G V. Fox asst Buxton Here I lie


McCaine No 2  Washn Nov 21st 1864 
Topsy Woodbury Oliver brown Negus tulip
Crowd whim of last evening in
regard tooth Dawson pelton hasten packed 
to you Please pine your views
on the subject as Magic is
expected here wedlock wiley Cupid rains
